observations: Photo shows a sewing machine head/arm with a label that appears to read “EM81”.
The machine appears to be an industrial-style sewing machine (heavy-duty body), but the photo does not show the full model plate, motor, or drive system clearly.
No clear view of needle area, presser foot, belt/gear layout, or whether it is direct-drive vs belt-driven.

claims.claim: Direct drive emel industrial sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows “EM81” marking but does not clearly show the drive system (direct vs belt/other) or the full machine/motor setup.

risks.risk: Drive type may not be direct-drive (could be belt/other drive), affecting value and compatibility with the buyer’s setup.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the motor-to-machine connection area (belt path/shaft coupling) or a short video showing the motor running and how power transmits to the machine head.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed direct-drive (worst case: treat as belt/unknown drive) and discount accordingly.

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (may be non-functional, needs servicing, or has worn parts).
risks.proof: Video of the machine sewing (threaded, stitching on fabric) plus a close-up of the needle/presser foot moving while running.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until proven, with a heavy discount.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (presser feet, bobbins, motor, table, wiring, foot pedal) can change total cost.
risks.proof: Photo list showing everything included: motor (if any), foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, presser feet, and any table/stand; plus a photo of the full setup laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as machine only (no guaranteed accessories) and discount to reflect missing parts risk.

risks.risk: Exact model/variant may differ from what’s implied by “EM81” marking (could be a similar-looking variant).
risks.proof: Photo of the full nameplate/model plate (front/back) with all text visible, including voltage/serial/model details.
risks.if_unproven: Price using the most generic industrial sewing machine assumption for EM81-like units, with uncertainty discounted.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the full machine including the motor/drive connection to confirm direct-drive vs belt/other.
Short video of it sewing (threaded) showing consistent stitching and needle movement.
Photo of the machine nameplate/model plate with all readable details (including serial/voltage).
Photos of what’s included: motor, foot pedal, cables, bobbins, needles, presser feet, and any table/stand.
response.reason: The photo only shows a partial marking (“EM81”) and does not confirm the key pricing drivers (direct-drive vs belt, working condition, and included accessories). Without those, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
